description: From outside the walls you take in the great star-shaped citadel of Jaca, its fortress ramparts standing with the Pyrenees looming behind. Floodlit bastions stand out against the black sky while the mountains are only a darker silhouette on the horizon. At four in the morning the whole place belongs to silence.
